title: BPO Communication Pre-Assessment
instructions: Read this passage aloud at a natural pace. Speak clearly, avoid filler words, and complete the entire passage.
content: A successful customer service representative listens carefully, communicates clearly, and remains calm when solving customer concerns. In a BPO environment, every conversation is an opportunity to build trust. Representatives should understand the customer’s concern, explain the available solution, and confirm that the concern has been addressed before ending the call. Professional communication requires patience, confidence, accurate information, and a respectful tone.
